'''Jedi librarians''', also called '''Jedi scholars''', were members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who had chosen to pursue the teachings of the [[Jedi Consular|Consular]], specializing as a [[Lore Keeper]]. These Jedi were dedicated to safeguarding and updating the Order's [[Jedi library|libraries]] and the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]].

==Overview==
[[File:Njo_markremedjev.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Chief Librarian/Legends|Chief Librarian]] [[Markre Medjev]] of the [[New Jedi Order|reformed Jedi Order]].]]
As a Lore Keeper, a Jedi could specialize in one or more of three sub-branches: the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]], [[Jedi historian]], or Jedi librarian. While all Lore Keepers made up the [[Librarian's Assembly]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], specialized librarians were charged with storage, organization and retrieval of knowledge. Not restricted to Coruscant, librarians were often assigned to satellite training facilities, most notably the academies of [[Kamparas Jedi Training Center|Kamparas]], [[Telosian Jedi Academy|Telos]], and [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]].<ref name="TJP" />

Librarians were at their greatest numbers when times were relatively peaceful; during war time, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Councils]] need as many Jedi in the field as possible, reducing the numbers that could stay within the academies. During the height of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], large groups of these Jedi would meet to discuss and analyze their most recent theories and findings. Many librarians wore the traditional [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] of the Order, though a set of robes with [[Ansata pattern/Legends|Ansata patterns]] on them saw use by some of the most prominent librarians of the Old Republic, as well as a more subdued green-hued robe.<ref name="TJP" />
